name: fastcac
description: Check business names, CAC fees and the CAC register, and register a Nigerian business from your FastCAC account.

interface.longDescription:
FastCAC registers Nigerian businesses with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC). In ChatGPT you can check whether a business name is available and follows CAC's rules, get name ideas and CAC's exact line-of-business wording, work out registration fees and annual returns, and search the CAC register or find a business's TIN.

Signed in to your FastCAC account, ChatGPT can also list your businesses and where each registration is, start a registration and fill in the form from what you tell it, and fetch your CAC certificate and documents. Paying, uploading documents and verifying your NIN always open on FastCAC for you to finish; ChatGPT never pays or sees your NIN. Changes to a paid registration ask you first, and you can disconnect ChatGPT at any time from Settings, Connected apps.
capabilities: Check business name availability and CAC naming rules
Work out CAC registration fees and annual returns
Search the CAC register and find a business's TIN
Start and fill in a business name registration
Show registration status and CAC documents
defaultPrompt: Is "Zuma Leather Ventures" available as a business name?
How much does it cost to register a company with ₦1m share capital?

positive.prompt: Is the business name "Kuda Bites Ventures" available with CAC?
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether the name looks available on the CAC register and lists the closest existing names.

positive.prompt: What will it cost to register a limited company with 1,000,000 naira share capital?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists name reservation, registration, stamp duty and Remita charges with a total.

positive.prompt: Search the CAC register for Dangote Cement.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching registered businesses with their RC numbers and status.

positive.prompt: Which businesses do I have on FastCAC and where is each registration?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's businesses with each registration's status and next step.

positive.prompt: Start registering a business name called "Ada Fresh Foods" for selling packaged food.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft business, sets CAC's line-of-business wording and the proposed name, and says what details are still missing.

negative.description: Tax filing isn't a CAC task
negative.prompt: File my company's income tax return with FIRS for this year.
Book me a flight from Lagos to Abuja.
Show me the NIN and address of the owner of Dangote Cement.

review.commerce_description: ChatGPT doesn't take payments. When a registration needs paying, it gives the person a FastCAC link and they pay on fastcac.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: CAC name, fee, register and TIN tools, and registrations from your FastCAC account.
